title: 崔丝塔娜·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 蓝色成年约德尔拥有大耳与浅色侧梳发，身旁保留静置的超大炮具。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Tristana is an adult blue-skinned yordle with large pointed ears, pale swept hair, bright focused eyes, and an oversized cannon. Her fully covering purple-and-brown scout jacket, gloves, trousers, and armored boots retain the champion’s natural compact stature without enlarged baby proportions; the cannon rests inactive on a low support.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sky blue, violet, warm brown, brass, pale stone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
